values.note: $30 a night (50-amp + water site). Reservations are non-refundable; one reschedule for a $15 change fee, by phone 14 business days ahead. Read 2026-11-03.

fees.source: Swiss Valley campsite pages on mycountyparks.com ('$30 /Night'; 'No refunds will be issued for camping reservations.'; 'A $15 change fee will be assessed per camping reservation item.'), read 2026-11-03

hookups.source: Swiss Valley campsite pages ('This 52 foot gravel back in site is available with 50 amp electricity and a water hookup.') and the county map legend ('CAMPER SITE RESERVABLE / 50 AMP', 'NON-RESERVABLE / 50 AMP'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: 54 camper sites (1-54, all 50 amp; 20 reservable) and 10 tent sites (55-64, no water). The reservable pads are 30-60 ft gravel back-ins.

sites.source: Dubuque County Swiss Valley Campgrounds map (camper sites 1-54, tent sites 55-64, '*NO TENT SITE HAS WATER AVAILABLE ON SITE') and the reservable campsite pages (pads 30-60 ft, every one 'gravel back in'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: About 30% of sites (20 camper, 2 tent) reservable online at least 4 days ahead; the rest first come, first served, and an unreserved reservable site may be taken first come. Confirm arrival at the self-registration kiosk. Check-in after 3 pm, check-out before 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/dubuque/Park/Swiss-Valley-Campground ('Only 30% of the campsites at Swiss Valley campground can be reserved online. The other 70% are first come, first served. Campsites used for reservations that are not reserved can be used on a first come, first served basis.'); campsite pages ('Reservations must be made 4 days in advance of the date of reservation'; 'No camping party or camping unit of any kind shall occupy any camp area for more than 14 days.'; 'Check-in is after 03:00 PM and check-out is before 02:00 PM.'), read 2026-11-03

note: Dubuque County Conservation campground off Whitetop Road near Peosta, 62 wooded acres on spring-fed Catfish Creek, a trout stream the Iowa DNR stocks each year. Two loops of gravel sites on an open bench with the tent sites below toward the creek; playground, sports fields, an enclosed pavilion to rent through the resident ranger. The Swiss Valley Nature Preserve and Center is a mile away. --Claude
summary: County pages, site pages and map read: $30 confirmed; 54 camper sites all 50 amp + water (20 reservable, 30-60 ft back-ins) + 10 tent sites -> count 64, max rig 60; reservable 4 days ahead, rest FCFS, 14-night limit; season Apr 1 - Nov 1 -> YEAR-ROUND (winter camping, water off); laundry and pull-through cleared. Not waterfront stands.
